input.quote: AbbVie shall cease any and all Exploitation of Licensed Compounds and Licensed Products and transfer to Harpoon, or destroy (at Harpoon's sole election), copies of all data and Information generated by AbbVie in connection with the Exploitation of Licensed Compounds or Licensed Products
input.rationale: Article 12's exit mechanics run in Harpoon's favour: Section 12.6.1(c) requires us to transfer or destroy data at Harpoon's election, while nothing obliges Harpoon to provide post-termination transition assistance or to return our data on a defined timeline. Section 9.7 (p0517/p0518) is request-based, runs only "as soon as reasonably practicable", and sets no 30-day export deadline or machine-readable format; the sell-off period in Section 12.10.2 (p0640) gives commercial wind-down but no data or transition support. We therefore add a single new Section 12.6.6 carrying the preferred position — transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Harpoon's then-current rates on expiry or termination, return of our data within 30 days in a standard machine-readable format, and deletion with written certification thereafter. Ninety days of assistance with a 30-day export would be an acceptable fallback.

ops.text: 12.6.6 Transition Assistance and Data Return. Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement, Harpoon shall (a) provide transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Harpoon's then-current rates; (b) within 30 days after expiry or termination, return all Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such Customer Data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing to AbbVie.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a single wind-down provision requiring Harpoon, on expiry or termination, to provide up to six (6) months of transition assistance at its then-current rates, return our data within 30 days in a standard machine-readable format, and then delete and certify deletion. Our playbook requires an orderly transition and data return before any deletion; 90 days of assistance with a 30-day export would be an acceptable fallback.
proposal.summary: Insert Section 12.6.6 requiring Harpoon transition assistance at then-current rates, 30-day machine-readable data return, and certified deletion.
